description: How often a complaint theme appears in 1-star reviews overall and by sector, and which apps get it most. App stores themes: login (Login & account access), crash (Crashes & won’t open), slow (Slow, loading & lag), update (Broke after an update), support (Customer service), billing (Charges, fees & refunds), payment (Payment or checkout fails), ux (Redesign & confusing UI), ads (Ads), notif (Notifications & alerts). Shopify App Store themes (market='shopify'): support (Slow or no support), bugs (Bugs & broke the store), billing (Charges & refunds), after_uninstall (Charged after uninstalling/cancelling), price_change (Price increases & plan changes), missing (Missing features & limits), slow (Slow store & app speed), leftover (Code left after uninstall), scam (Called it a scam or misleading), expensive (Too expensive for what it does), hard (Hard to use or set up), lockin (Export, import & migration pain), sync (Sync, orders & inventory errors). Omit theme to get the ranking of all themes.

theme.description: Theme key or words, e.g. 'login', 'ads', 'refund', 'crash'. Optional.
